name: Bun rieu cua
summary: Crab noodle soup: the crab is pounded, mixed with egg, and set into brown-gold sheets you can break with chopsticks, with seaweed in the pot. A full herb plate comes alongside.
origin: Quy Nhon, a bowl tied to the silt of the Kôn River.
texture: The crab custard sets into sheets you can break with chopsticks.
howToEat: Add the herb plate: shredded banana flower, perilla, rau răm, bean sprouts, and young lettuce.
seoTitle: Bun rieu cua — Quy Nhon crab noodles
seoDescription: Quy Nhon bún riêu cua is pounded crab set with egg into brown-gold sheets, with seaweed in the broth and a full plate of herbs.
